Nuvama Private Wealth

Nuvama Private Wealth, a core brand under the Nuvama Group, is a leading integrated financial services platform in India, offering high-net-worth clients professional wealth management, access to private market opportunities, and diversified financial solutions.

Business Architecture

Private Wealth Management

Providing professional wealth planning, asset allocation, and long-term wealth management solutions for HNIs, UHNIs, affluent families, family offices, and corporate clients.

Primary Market Investments

Focused on delivering premium primary market investment opportunities, including Pre-IPO, OTC deals, and other scarce equity allocation opportunities, helping clients capture first-mover advantages.

Global Network

A strong service network across domestic and international markets, with 100+ offices and 3,400+ professional team members.

Our Investment Philosophy
